name: How long does a whole house remodel typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a whole house remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole house remodel varies significantly based on the scope, size of your home, and complexity of the changes. A major renovation can take anywhere from several months to over a year. Factors like obtaining permits, material lead times, and unforeseen structural issues can influence the timeline. We work to establish a detailed project schedule upfront, and clear communication throughout the project helps manage expectations regarding completion dates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Whole house remodels vary in length, typically several months to over a year, depending on scope and complexity. Permit times and material availability also affect the schedule.
